title: Pantry Horor Jam Lembur
theme: Mengeksplorasi kecemasan tersembunyi dan absurditas di balik rutinitas kerja malam yang monoton, menemukan keunikan dalam kegilaan sehari-hari.

cover.prompt: A serene late-night scene: An open laptop rests on a minimal desk, its screen casting a soft, warm amber glow. The digital clock on the laptop prominently displays '01:00'. Through a wide window in the background, a quiet city's gentle lights twinkle softly, enveloped in deep blue-grey hues of the very early morning. The atmosphere is one of peaceful solitude and focused contemplation. Cinematic composition, utilizing the rule of thirds with a shallow depth of field, capturing the gentle screen glow and the subdued urban landscape.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A cynical employee working late discovers strange, human-like noises in the deserted office pantry. Annoyed rather than scared, they investigate, only to find another colleague secretly enjoying leftover food, revealing the shared absurdity of late-night office life.
meta.target_emotion: Amused curiosity, lighthearted tension, a sense of relatable absurdity.
